description: Champion contributions go unnoticed; there is no form of recognition or reward.
Recognition happens occasionally and informally (e.g., a verbal thank-you), with no consistent system.
A basic recognition mechanism exists (e.g., shout-outs, small perks) but isn't applied consistently across champions.
A structured system consistently recognizes and rewards champion contributions, combining tangible and intangible recognition.
A well-established, fair recognition and reward system is embedded into career development and performance processes, visibly valued across the organization.
